content.title: NCAA Tournament results: Texas, Texas A&M, High Point all pull off early upsets while No. 1 Duke survives vs. Siena
content.text: 6d ago / 12:45 AM EDTGonzaga holds off Kennesaw State to punch ticket to second roundThe third-seeded Bulldogs couldn't exhale until the final moments of their 73-64 win over No. 14 Kennesaw State because from the very start, the Owls had looked capable of becoming the fourth double-digit seed to win Thursday.But a second-half surge was enough to give the Bulldogs a 12-point lead with 5:28 left in regulation. The Owls winnowed it down to 67-62 with 2 minutes to play, but Gonzaga grabbed its own offensive rebound from a miss and scored a layup in a key sequence that helped stop the Owls from getting any closer.Next up for Gonzaga is a matchup Saturday against No. 11 Texas.6d ago / 12:35 AM EDTThe day might not be out of upsets yetAll that's left in the first day of the tournament is the final minutes of the final game — and yet Kennesaw State is in striking distance of taking down third-seeded Gonzaga.The Owls trail just 69-64 with 1:42 left in regulation. 6d ago / 12:29 AM EDTHouston blows out Idaho, advances to face Texas A&MThe Cougars, last year's national runner-up, were never really threatened in their first-round rout of Idaho after leading by 24 at halftime. Houston won by a final score of 78-47, and earned its way into a second-round matchup Saturday against Texas A&M after the 10th-seeded Aggies upset Saint Mary's earlier in the day. 6d ago / 12:20 AM EDT12-4 Gonzaga run puts pressure on Kennesaw State Over a three-minute stretch midway through the sescond half, the third-seeded Bulldogs finally gave themselves some breathing room by opening up a 12-2 run that put them ahead by double digits at 55-44. Gonzaga found success against the Owls' 1-3-1 zone. Over the next five minutes, the Bulldogs' lead hovered around double digits, and they currently lead 63-53 with four minutes left in regulation.6d ago / 12:16 AM EDTSaint Louis crushes Georgia, will play Michigan in round of 32According to the seeds, No. 9 Saint Louis's 102-77 win over eighth-seeded Georgia was technically an upset, but anyone who watched the game saw one team that was clearly superior. That win gives Saint Louis a chance to stun the tournament in Saturday's round of 32, when the Billikens will face Michigan, the top seed in the Midwest region. In its NCAA tournament history, Saint Louis has never won consecutive games. 6d ago / 11:57 PM EDTIllinois blows past Penn to move into second roundThe Illini left no doubt against 14th-seeded Penn in a 105-70 win that pushes Illinois into a second-round matchup against No. 11 VCU on Saturday. 6d ago / 11:42 PM EDTFour games on, but only one remains competitiveThe last four games of the day are all in the second half, but only one is worth watching at this point: Kennesaw State-Gonzaga.The 14th-seeded Owls trail the favored Bulldogs, 35-27, early in the second half. They've put a scare into Gonzaga led by Kaden Rickard's 10 points off the bench. Gonzaga's starters have made just nine of their 21 shots.In the other games, Illinois is cruising to a win over Penn with a lead of 94-57.Houston is leading Idaho, 53-33. And Saint Louis is crushing Georgia, 71-44.6d ago / 11:31 PM EDTIllinois star has double-double to build big leadDavid Mirkovic of Illinois has 25 points and 15 rebounds with seven minutes left to help his team lead Penn comfortably, 79-51. Most impressive about Mirkovic's performance is that he's grabbed seven offensive rebounds — Penn, as a team, has just five — and committed zero fouls.If Penn is still harboring upset hopes, it needs to start a turnaround now.7d ago / 11:17 PM EDTWe've got a game in PortlandNo. 3 Gonzaga leads just 33-27 at halftime of its first-round game against 14th-seeded Kennesaw State, and the Bulldogs are fortunate to be ahead after making 1 of 9 3-pointers. They closed on a 10-0 run to the half, though, not allowing the Owls to score for the last two minutes.7d ago / 11:11 PM EDTSaint Louis dominating Georgia at halfThe No. 9 Billikens lead the No. 8 Bulldogs 49-32 at half. Saint Louis has gotten it done on the glass, outrebounding Georgia 30-16, and with passing. Fifteen of St. Louis' field goals have come on assists compared to only two from their opponent. Guard Dion Brown leads the Billikens with 10 points at half. Georgia only got six total points from its starters but Jeremiah Wilkinson has 16 off the bench. 7d ago / 11:05 PM EDTKennesaw State is giving Gonzaga problems Playing in Portland against a pro-Gonzaga crowd that made the drive from Spokane, Washington, Kennesaw State hasn't looked the slightest bit unprepared for the Big Dance. The Owls have led the third-seeded Bulldogs frequently tonight, only falling behind, 21-20, with about six minutes left before halftime. But then the Owls answered to lead 25-21.The Bulldogs have won nine consecutive first-round games, but tonight they're 0-for-8 on 3-pointers thus far.7d ago / 11:05 PM EDTNo. 2 Houston is blowing out IdahoNo one in the country has made the NCAA tournament's round of 16 more consistently than Houston, which has done it six consecutive years. Barring a wild comeback from their first-round opponent Idaho tonight, the Cougars look to at least be headed to the round of 32.Houston leads 46-24 with a minute to play before halftime. Chris Cenac Jr. of Houston has nine defensive rebounds — one more than the entire Idaho roster. 7d ago / 10:41 PM EDTIllinois leads Penn 40-30 at halftimeThe third-seeded Illini are trying to avoid becoming the latest upset victim and have built a 10-point halftime lead in part by holding No. 14 Penn without even a single free-throw attempt. Illinois, which plays one of the tallest lineups in the country, also has twice as many rebounds, 28-14.7d ago / 10:38 PM EDTGonzaga's 27th consecutive NCAA tournament is under wayGonzaga, which trails against Kennesaw State, 6-2, early in the last game of the day, is making its 27th consecutive NCAA tournament appearance. Only Michigan State (28) and Kansas (36) hold longer active streaks.7d ago / 10:33 PM EDTKelvin Sampson has 827 wins. Can he get six more for a title?One year after Houston was denied for a national championship in the 2025 title game against Florida, coach Kelvin Sampson has the Cougars back as a top title contender this season. The second-seeded Cougars have opened the tournament tonight against Idaho and lead 21-12 in the first half.Sampson's win total of 827 ranks 14th all-time in NCAA history. If he gets to 833 this season, he'll have won his first national championship.7d ago / 10:28 PM EDTIllinois can't get rid of PennUnderdog Penn had gone on a 9-0 run over a 3-minute stretch in the first half to stay within four points if Illinois, and playing a zone defense the Quakers are still within striking distance as a 14th seed. David Mirkovic already has 12 points in 14 minutes for the Illini, which lead 29-25 with 4:47 left before halftime.7d ago / 10:21 PM EDTGeorgia vs. St. Louis underwayThe Bulldogs have won seven of their last nine games and enter as a No. 8 seed. The Billikens, meanwhile, have split their last eight games. Senior big man Robbie Avila leads them in both scoring and assists. 7d ago / 10:10 PM EDTWill Penn be the latest Cinderella of the night?Making its first tournament appearance since 2018, 14th-seeded Penn has tipped off against third-seed Illinois in Greenville, South Carolina. The Quakers trail, 7-6, four minutes into the game.7d ago / 9:59 PM EDTLonghorns go from First Four to second roundTexas barely won, needing a last-second shot, in the "First Four" round earlier this week just to earn the No. 11 seed in the West. Now, after a 79-71 win over sixth-seeded BYU, the Longhorns have advanced to the round of 32 under coach Sean Miller. Matas Vokietaitis scored 23 points to go with 16 rebounds for Texas.Star BYU freshman A.J. Dybantsa scored 35 points and added 10 rebounds to show why he has a case to be the No. 1 overall pick in the NBA draft in June, but the Cougars struggled otherwise to score after falling behind by nine at halftime. 7d ago / 9:56 PM EDTTexas A&M is third double-digit seed to winTenth-seeded Texas A&M has beaten Saint Mary's, 63-50, making the Aggies the third double-digit seed of the day to win in an upset, joining High Point and VCU. Rashaun Agee led the Aggies in points (22), rebounds (nine) and assists (three). Saint Mary's had made the second round in three of its previous four NCAA tournament appearances since 2022, but was dropped in the opening round Thursday in Oklahoma City after it struggled with 18 turnovers. 7d ago / 9:39 PM EDTNot enough offense for Saint Mary'sSaint Mary's guard Joshua Dent has made seven of his 11 field-goal attempts today against Texas A&M to lead the Gaels in scoring with 18 points. Outside of Dent, though, the rest of his team has combined to make 11 of 33 shots. The 10th-seeded Aggies lead, 63-50, with 51 seconds left in regulation.7d ago / 9:38 PM EDTMichigan dominates second half en route to victory over HowardThe Wolverines went into half only up four point on the No. 16 Bison. They ended the game up 21, securing a relatively straightforward 101-80 win. The Howard offense dried up in second frame, and Michigan showed just why they're considered one of the favorites to lift the title. Next up on Saturday: The winner of Georgia and Saint Louis. 7d ago / 9:37 PM EDTBYU mounting comebackThe Cougars trailed by 17 points early in the second half but have had a huge comeback to pull within six points with 2:16 remaining in the game. Will star freshman AJ Dybantsa be able to will BYU to victory? 7d ago / 9:24 PM EDTOnce trailing by 19, VCU stuns North Carolina in upsetWhat a comeback, and what an ending.With North Carolina trailing VCU, 80-78, with 4.2 seconds left in overtime, UNC big man Henri Veesaar, a 62% free-throw shooter this season, missed the first free throw. He then missed the second intentionally but couldn't corral the rebound to try for a putback. From there, 11th-seeded VCU extended its lead on free throws and won, 82-78. Terrence Hill Jr. was the game-changing star, with 34 points off the bench.North Carolina has lost three of its last five tournament openers.7d ago / 9:22 PM EDTAggies on track to spring upset on Saint Mary'sTexas A&M is leading Saint Mary's comfortably, 53-33, with 10 minutes left in regulation, which could give this day another double-digit upset if it holds. The Aggies have been able to get inside with ease, outscoring the Gaels 24-6 in the paint. 7d ago / 9:15 PM EDTTexas has opened it up on BYUThe No. 11 seed looks primed for a first-round upset as the Longhorns now lead the Cougars 68-53 with 10 minutes remaining in the game. Matas Vokietaitis has 19 points and 14 rebounds to lead Texas while BYU is (of course) led by AJ Dybantsa's 26 points. If BYU can't mount a comeback, Dybantsa will begin NBA prep tomorrow. 7d ago / 9:14 PM EDTAll defense in UNC-VCU overtimeWell, it took 3 minutes, but a team has scored in the overtime between VCU and North Carolina. A VCU layup in traffic put the Rams ahead 77-75, but the Tar Heels quickly answered with free throws. The teams combined to start overtime 1 for 10 on field goals. This game will come down to the wire with only 1:45 remaining in overtime.7d ago / 9:04 PM EDTOvertime in VCU-North CarolinaOnce trailing by 19 points, VCU has forced overtime against North Carolina, 75-75. Terrence Hill Jr. scored the tying basket, a layup, with 9 seconds to play, which gave the Tar Heels another chance to win. After a balky possession that ended in a Tar Heels turnover, VCU got the ball back with 2.9 seconds left in regulation for its own game-winning opportunity. Fittingly, a wild second half ended with VCU throwing the ball away, and North Carolina heaved a 3-pointer at the buzzer that missed.To overtime we go!7d ago / 9:02 PM EDTTexas A&M is widening its lead on No. 7 Saint Mary'sUpset alert! The Aggies lead, 44-29, over Saint Mary's with 16 minutes to go in the second half. Saint Mary's has won five of its last six games against double-digit seeds, but is struggling mightily with its own mistakes in this game. 7d ago / 9:01 PM EDTMichigan starting to create some distanceHoward has been hanging around admirably, thanks to some sharp 3-point shooting. The issue? The Wolverines are shooting 70% from the field. It'll be near impossible for the Bison to claw back if that holds up. Michigan leads 70-59 with 13:25 to go. 7d ago / 8:53 PM EDTTerrence Hill Jr.'s heroics have put UNC on upset alertWith 27 points, VCU guard Terrence Hill Jr. is putting on a show to keep the Rams in their first-round game against sixth-seeded North Carolina. Sixteen of Hill's points have come in the second half, and now North Carolina leads by only 74-70 with 2:14 to play in the second half. 7d ago / 8:39 PM EDTBench points keeping VCU in it against North CarolinaNorth Carolina has led fairly comfortably against VCU in this South region game, and currently holds a 70-56 lead with seven minutes to play in the second half. What is keeping VCU in this game is how it is tapping into its strong bench play to outscore North Carolina's reserves, 24-7. VCU's bench has been one of the nation's highest-scoring all season.7d ago / 8:31 PM EDTTexas holds 46-37 lead on BYU at halftimeTexas played well down the stretch and finished the half strong, ending on a 25-foot 3-pointer by Tramon Mack with time expiring. The Longhorns lead BYU by nine at the break. Texans center Matas Vokietaitis had a huge first half with 15 points and 11 rebounds. BYU was led by star freshman AJ Dybantsa's 20 points. 7d ago / 8:26 PM EDTNo. 7 Saint Mary's is on upset alertCommitting 11 turnovers, more than their season average, in the first half has put the Gaels on upset alert, trailing 10th-seeded Texas A&M, 37-26, at halftime. Ruben Dominguez has filled it up with 11 points and three 3-pointers.7d ago / 8:22 PM EDTThree-point shooting keeping Howard in itIf you like points, you'll like what you're witnessing in Buffalo. We've already seen 17 3-pointers in the first half!Howard's sharpshooting prowess has them within distance of No. 1 seed Michigan. It's a lot to ask a No. 16 seed to keep shooting 60% from deep but they'll likely need to stay in that neighborhood to have a chance against this athletic Wolverines squad. The boys from Ann Arbor only have a four-point lead at the break. 7d ago / 8:15 PM EDTNorth Carolina's lead is ballooning in second halfThe Tar Heels have pushed their lead to 56-37 with 15 minutes to play after a corner 3-pointer by Seth Trimble was part of an 8-3 UNC run.7d ago / 8:08 PM EDTTexas leads 30-25 with 6:42 left in first halfAJ Dybantsa, the potential No. 1 pick in the upcoming NBA Draft is in full takeover mode (14 points in 13 minutes) but he needs help. Texas is shooting 57% from the field and sharing the ball well. They hold a small lead down the stretch of the first half. 7d ago / 8:07 PM EDTHoward hanging around in the first halfMichigan may have the size advantage but some sharp shooting from deep has the Bison only down five as we approach halftime in Buffalo. The Wolverines lead 34-29 with 6:18 left in the first half. 7d ago / 8:06 PM EDT'Baby Bird' having early impact for Saint Mary'sLiam Campbell, who wears No. 33 in homage to Larry Bird and has a blond mop of hair like him, too, has come off the bench for Saint Mary's to hit two 3-pointers early. The Gaels trail Texas A&M, 17-13, halfway through the first half, but Saint Mary's has been plagued by turnovers, with seven already, including two halfcourt violations. 7d ago / 7:48 PM EDTNorth Carolina leads VCU, 39-28, at halftimeThe Tar Heels' winning recipe in the first half started with holding onto the ball. They had just one turnover, to five from VCU, and that along with UNC's 22-12 advantage in scoring in the paint is the difference. 7d ago / 7:46 PM EDTNo early-game jitters for MichiganThe Wolverines come out firing in Buffalo, hitting three of their first four 3-point attempts. The size and speed difference is noticeable in the early going, with Michigan racing out to a 14-6 lead six minutes into the game. 7d ago / 7:40 PM EDTNo. 11 Texas and No. 6 BYU underwayA balanced Texas lineup squares off with one of the nation's best players in BYU's AJ Dybantsa. He's exepcted to be among the top two selections in the upcoming NBA Draft. 7d ago / 7:38 PM EDTNo. 7 Saint Mary's tips off against No. 10 Texas A&MIn the South region, the seventh-seeded Gaels are facing the Aggies, who have won four straight tournament openers when seeded ninth or worse. 7d ago / 7:33 PM EDTNo. 1 Michigan tips off against No. 16 Howard A Big Ten powerhouse takes on the class of the Mid-Eastern Atlantic Conference. The Bison are heavy underdogs but come in having won 13 of its last 14 games. 7d ago / 7:33 PM EDTOffense at a premium in VCU-UNCThere have been just two — two! — fastbreak points combined in the South region first-round matchup between Virginia Commonwealth and North Carolina, which the Tar Heels lead 24-18 with 7 minutes before halftime.These teams have shot 4-for-18 on 3-pointers, as well.7d ago / 7:12 PM EDTVCU is heating up and hanging aroundAfter missing its first five shots, 11th-seeded VCU has made four of its last five to lead sixth-seeded North Carolina, 10-9, five minutes into the first half. VCU came into today having won 16 of its last 17 games.It's trying to take down a UNC team that is 33-3 all-time in opening games of the NCAA tournament — but under coach Hubert Davis, the Tar Heels have lost two of their last four openers.7d ago / 6:55 PM EDTNo. 6 North Carolina tips off against No. 11 VCUThe winner of this game in the South Region will face the winner of tonight's Penn-Illinois matchup.7d ago / 6:37 PM EDTNo. 3 Michigan State wins in rout, next faces LouisvilleOn their way to a 92-67 win over 14th-seeded North Dakota State, the Spartans controlled their matchup from the start, led by Jeremy Fears Jr., whose 11 assists tied for second-most in MSU's tournament history. MSU had 26 assists overall, the most in its lengthy tournament history.With the win, Michigan State advances into a round of 32 matchup in the East Region on Saturday against sixth-seeded Louisville.7d ago / 6:33 PM EDTArkansas moves onA relatively painless victory for the Razorbacks, who dispatched Hawai'i 97-78. Darius Acuff Jr. had 24 points for Arkansas, while Meleek Thomas added 21. All five starters for the Razorbacks were in double digits.Arkansas will play High Point in the second round, after the No. 12 Panthers upset No. 5 Wisconsin earlier Thursday. 7d ago / 6:21 PM EDTMichigan State up big on North Dakota StateMichigan State coach Tom Izzo's 59 tournament wins is tied for fifth-most all time among coaches, but he's only five minutes from his 60th as his team leads North Dakota State by 17. The Bison are on an 8-0 run but still trail big after allowing MSU to shoot 60% today.7d ago / 6:20 PM EDTArkansas cruising toward victoryThe Razorbacks have opened up an 81-60 lead against Hawai'i with 7:54 to go. In his first tournament game, point guard Darius Acuff Jr. has 22 points and four assists. 7d ago / 6:03 PM EDTNorth Dakota State can't cut into double-digit deficitWith only 11 minutes to play in regulation between Michigan State and North Dakota State, the underdog Bison have been unable to put a dent into their 20-point halftime deficit. Michigan State has been overwhelming since the second half began and had an answer for every NDSU basket.7d ago / 5:57 PM EDTArkansas remains in front of Hawai'iThe Razorbacks lead 66-49 with under 14 minutes to go. Four Arkansas starters have scored at least 11 points. 7d ago / 5:43 PM EDTSecond half under way in Michigan State-North Dakota StateThe third-seeded Spartans lead 47-27 early in the second half after Carson Cooper added to his team-high point total with 16, on 5-of-5 shooting. 7d ago / 5:32 PM EDTFour more threes for High Point sharpshooter in win vs. WisconsinHigh Point's Chase Johnston hit four massive triples — and one crucial, unexpected deuce — on Thursday that moved him up in the college record books.He’s made 415 career long ones, moving him up to No. 22 on the all-time NCAA leaderboard. Johnston passed previous No. 22 Steph Curry, the 3-point icon and former Davidson star. And no, Johnston — who has previously played for Stetson and Florida Gulf Coast — didn’t think about pulling up for 3 before scoring the winning bucket. “When (teammate) Rob (Martin) threw that (outlet pass) up, I was just like, ‘I gotta put this in the in the hoop and win this game,'" he told reporters after High Point's upset win over Wisconsin. "I wasn’t really thinking whether it’s a 2 or 3. I was just trying to put it in and win this game.”7d ago / 5:26 PM EDTVanderbilt survives upset scare from 12-seed McNeese StateIt wasn't the prettiest, but the Commodores got it done for their first NCAA Tournament win since the Obama administration. Vandy trailed for most of the first half before taking a lead right ahead of the break. They kept the Cowboys at bay in the second half and worked to drain the clock late to secure a 78-68 win. Standout sophomore Tyler Tanner led the way with 26 points. 7d ago / 5:23 PM EDTMichigan State up big on North Dakota StateMichigan State, the third seed in the East region, has hit halftime leading North Dakota State, 45-25. Carson Cooper leads the Spartans with 14 points, while the Bison have made only two of their 15 3-point attempts.7d ago / 5:19 PM EDTArkansas extends lead at halftimeThe Razorbacks are up 54-39 at the break against Hawai'i. 7d ago / 5:11 PM EDTArkansas leads Hawai'i The Razorbacks have a 44-34 advantage over the Rainbow Warriors with under four minutes to go in the first half. 7d ago / 5:10 PM EDTOnly two No. 16 seeds have ever upset a 1-seedSiena almost became the third No. 16 seed to ever topple a No. 1 seed. Here are the only times it happened:2018: UMBC beat Virginia, 74-542023: Farleigh Dickinson beat Purdue, 63-587d ago / 5:10 PM EDTVandy holds firm as McNeese offense stallsThe Cowboys chose a rough time to sputter. After cutting the Commodores' lead to three, they haven't scored in nearly three minutes. Vanderbilt leads by five and is slowly closing in on its first NCAA Tournament win in 14 years. 7d ago / 5:04 PM EDTDuke survives scare from No. 16 seed SienaSiena led by double digits at halftime but looked gassed down the stretch, as coach Gerry McNamara decided to play his starters for almost the entirety of the 40-minute game. He made his first substitution in the final minute. The Blue Devils surged toward the end to take a 71-65 win.7d ago / 5:02 PM EDTMcNeese keeping things closeThanks to their rebounding efforts, the Cowboys are staying just in reach of Vanderbilt midway through the second half.Trailing just six points with six minutes to go, they'll at least have a look at making an upset push down the stretch. 7d ago / 4:58 PM EDTSiena's shot might be slipping awayLots of close calls here down the stretch. Duke's Dame Sarr blocked Siena's Riley Mulvey at the rim, and then Siena had a 3-pointer hit the rim and spin out of the basket. Duke now leads 67-61 with 1:30 remaining. Siena has gone 6:20 without scoring now.7d ago / 4:54 PM EDTCam Boozer is Duke's closerBoozer, the Blue Devils' talented freshman forward, took the ball to the paint, drew a foul and hit both free throws. At the other end of the court, he blocked a Siena shot. The Blue Devils are now up 65-61.On the game, Boozer has 20 points, 12 rebounds and 3 assists.7d ago / 4:48 PM EDTDuke regains lead late in the second halfWith under five minutes to play, Duke finally regained the lead for the first time since the 15:31 mark in the first half. The Blue Devils are up 63-61 with 3:56 remaining. 7d ago / 4:43 PM EDTSiena looks absolutely gassedThe Saints are hanging by a thread, leading 61-60 with 5:46 to go in the second half. Siena hasn’t made a single substitution all game, and it looks to be wearing down the players on the floor. The Saints look incredibly fatigued as this game is going on. Duke will have the ball and a chance to take the lead out of the timeout. 7d ago / 4:40 PM EDTSolid passing propelling VanderbiltThe Commodores are nursing a 3-point lead early in the second half against the McNeese State Cowboys from Lake Charles, Louisiana. Vanderbilt has 14 assists on 16 made shots, a testament to how well they've found open looks so far. The Nashvillians lead 45-42. 7d ago / 4:39 PM EDTHigh Point's Chase Johnston finally scores from up close It was a minor miracle High Point’s Chase Johnston knew what to do with the basketball so close to the hoop.The graduate transfer and 3-point specialist entered the NCAA Tournament with a fascinating 2025-26 stat line, only possible in analytics-driven modern basketball: 64-for-132 from distance and 0-for-4 from inside the arc.Johnston took an outlet pass from Rob Martin and went in for the game-winning layup, his first 2-point score of the season, in High Point's 83-82 stunner over Wisconsin.7d ago / 4:32 PM EDTSiena starting to settle inSiena finally ended an 11-0 run by Duke and now the teams are trading blows. It’s 53-49 Saints with 12:30 to go in the second half. 7d ago / 4:29 PM EDTMichigan State, Arkansas now underway against double-digit seeds Tom Izzo and No. 3 seed Michigan State are taking on No. 14 North Dakota State, while John Calipari and No. 4 Arkansas face No. 13 Hawai'i.7d ago / 4:26 PM EDTDuke within 4 as Siena has gone coldSiena’s lead has shrunk to 47-43 as the Saints can’t buy a bucket in the second half. Duke's zone defense has stymied Siena, which also looks to be getting a little tired as the Saints have yet to play anyone off their bench.Cameron Boozer is up to 15 points. 7d ago / 4:20 PM EDTDuke cuts the lead to single digitsSiena’s lead is now 47-38 with 16 minutes to go after two Cameron Boozer free throws. The Saints haven’t rested their starters for even a second — they’ve played all 24 minutes of action so far. Can Siena avoid fatigue as we head toward the homestretch? 7d ago / 4:11 PM EDTIs your bracket already busted?You have No. 12 seed High Point to blame.7d ago / 4:08 PM EDTMcNeese State only trails by 3 at halftimeWe've already seen one 12-5 upset today, as High Point edged out Wisconsin by one point. Could we see another in short order? McNeese State upset Clemson in last year's tournament and is looking for another today against No. 5 Vanderbilt.The Cowboys led by double digits at one point, but now trail 38-35 at halftime. They aren't shooting the ball particularly well, but have gotten nine points apiece from Tyshawn Archie and Larry Johnson.7d ago / 3:58 PM EDTDuke needs to find its offense in the second halfThe Blue Devils are shooting only 39% from the field against Siena, including a putrid 13% from three-point land. Duke is lucky to be down only 11 considering the Saints are shooting 55% from the field and 45% from deep.The Boozer brothers (Cameron and Cayden) have been great, scoring 21 points on 7-12 shooting. The rest of the team has 11 points on 4-16 from the field. 7d ago / 3:55 PM EDTLouisville survives South Florida press, secures first tourney win since 2017The Cardinals led this game by more than 20 points at one point, and the Bulls clawed their way back thanks to to a suffocating full-court press. Louisville ended up turning the ball over 22 times, but its 3-point shooting proved to be the difference. The Cardinals shot 52% from deep (13-25), to hold off the Bulls for a 83-79 win.Louisville will now play the winner of No. 3 seed Michigan State vs. No. 14 North Dakota State.7d ago / 3:54 PM EDTNo. 12 High Point upsets No. 5 Wisconsin!The Badgers’ last-second inbounds pass was intercepted and the Panthers will move on! We have our first 12-5 upset of the tournament!Rob Martin was sensational for High Point, scoring 23 points. Nick Boyd and John Blackwell combined to score 49 in a losing effort for Wisconsin. 7d ago / 3:52 PM EDTWisconsin ball with 1.8 seconds left7d ago / 3:51 PM EDTNo. 16 Siena leads No. 1 Duke 43-32 at halftimeThe Saints have the first lead for the 16-seed at halftime since 2019. Siena has been lights out offensively, and a late switch to zone has helped keep Duke’s offense at bay. 7d ago / 3:50 PM EDTWisconsin shot blocked!The Badgers’ go-ahead attempt was rejected! High Point has the ball and an 83-82 lead with 1.6 seconds left!7d ago / 3:49 PM EDTHigh Point takes the lead!High Point gets out on a fast break and takes an 83-82 lead with 11 seconds to go! Wisconsin has the ball after the timeout.7d ago / 3:48 PM EDTMidway through first half, McNeese State holds onto leadThe Cowboys lead No. 5 seed Vanderbilt 26-20, with under eight minutes to play in the first half. They have four players who have scored at least five points. 7d ago / 3:44 PM EDTGreat drama in Portland!It's back and forth for High Point and Wisconsin, featuring some great shot-making down the stretch. The Panthers trail the Badgers by just one point, and the next 55 seconds (or longer!) will decide if we have our first big upset of March.7d ago / 3:43 PM EDTUnder two minutes to play, South Florida within six pointsThe Bulls have the Cardinals in a vise grip with this full-court press. South Florida only trails Louisville 78-72, but has possession with 1:37 remaining.7d ago / 3:41 PM EDTSiena 35, Duke 26 with 3:49 to go in halfAction has tightened slightly as we approach halftime.Francis Folefac and Gavin Doty have combined for 21 points for the Saints so far, while the Boozer brothers have 17 for the Blue Devils. 7d ago / 3:38 PM EDTHigh Point Panthers make their pushThe No. 12 seed from the Big South Conference has made things very tense for Wisconsin. Just as the Badgers were pulling away, a quick High Point spurt has brought it to a two-point game. Wisconsin leads 72-70 with three minutes to go. 7d ago / 3:37 PM EDTSiena is still on a heaterThe Saints have a 33-24 lead with under seven minutes to go. Siena is shooting 57% from the field, including 56% from deep. 7d ago / 3:35 PM EDTSouth Florida really annoying Louisville down the stretchWhatever happens the rest of the way, credit to the Bulls for keeping this game close with their full-court press.
